0:
modules:
  wiim:
    http_client_config:
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true

    metrics:
      - name: cpu_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .temperature_cpu }"
        help: CPU temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: cpu
      - name: tmp102_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .temperature_tmp102 }"
        help: TMP102 temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: tmp102

modules:
  renovate:
    http_client_config:
      authorization:
        credentials_file: /credentials/renovate.txt

    metrics:
      - name: renovate_organization_count
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .app.organizationCount }"
        help: The number of organizations known to renovate

      - name: renovate_repository_count
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .app.repositoryCount }"
        help: The number of repositories known to renovate

      - name: renovate_jobs_processed
        valuetype: counter
        path: "{ .jobs.history.processed }"
        help: The number of jobs processed since the instance has started

      - name: renovate_queue_size
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .jobs.queue.size }"
        help: The number of jobs currently in the queue

# Wait for the API to be ready, then push Qdrant/LocalAI config
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost:8765/docs 2>/dev/null; then
    wget -q -O- --post-data='{"openmemory":{"custom_instructions":""},"mem0":{"vector_store":{"provider":"qdrant","config":{"collection_name":"mem0","host":"qdrant.cortex.svc.cluster.local","port":6333,"embedding_model_dims":768}},"llm":{"provider":"openai","config":{"model":"mistral-7b-instruct","temperature":0.1,"max_tokens":2048,"openai_base_url":"http://local-ai-intel.cortex.svc.cluster.local:8080/v1","api_key":"not-needed"}},"embedder":{"provider":"openai","config":{"model":"nomic-embed-text","openai_base_url":"http://local-ai-intel.cortex.svc.cluster.local:8080/v1","api_key":"not-needed","embedding_dims":768}}}}' \
      --header='Content-Type: application/json' \
      'http://localhost:8765/api/v1/config/openmemory' > /dev/null 2>&1 && break
  fi
  sleep 2
done &

set -e
# Ensure plugins directory exists (symlinked from /var/www/html/plugins)
mkdir -p /pelican-data/plugins
# Copy vendor from image to emptyDir (only if empty)
if [ ! -f /mnt/vendor/autoload.php ]; then
  echo "Copying vendor directory..."
  cp -a /var/www/html/vendor/. /mnt/vendor/
fi
# Install composer if not present
if [ ! -f /pelican-data/bin/composer ]; then
  mkdir -p /pelican-data/bin
  wget -q -O /pelican-data/bin/composer https://getcomposer.org/download/latest-stable/composer.phar
  chmod +x /pelican-data/bin/composer
fi
# Install plugin composer dependencies into the shared vendor dir
cd /var/www/html
/pelican-data/bin/composer require socialiteproviders/pocketid:^5.0 --no-interaction --no-progress --no-scripts
/pelican-data/bin/composer dump-autoload --no-scripts --optimize
# Copy composer to shared bin dir for main container
cp /pelican-data/bin/composer /shared-bin/composer
echo "Plugin dependencies ready"
